name: Bing Wallpaper
author: Karol Wylizinski
description: Syncs your background to Bing's image of the day, keeps a browsable library of the last days, and survives theme switches.

barWidget.description: Today's Bing image of the day with its title and copyright, and one click to make it your background.

schema.label: Region
schema.description: Bing serves a different image per region. 'auto' follows your system locale, falling back to en-US.

schema.label: Resolution
schema.description: UHD is roughly 4 MB per image; the smaller sizes are a few hundred kilobytes.

schema.label: Apply new images automatically
schema.description: Turn off to download in the background and pick images by hand.

schema.label: Keep the Bing image after a theme switch
schema.description: Omarchy resets the background when you change themes. This puts the Bing image back — but only when it was the background beforehand.

schema.label: Shuffle the library instead
schema.description: Apply a random downloaded image on each check rather than today's.
